faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Dell Latitude 5400 and 5401, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: What does US International layout mean?
faqs.answer: US International keeps the standard US key positions but adds support for typing accented characters and other symbols used in European languages.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this version includes backlighting to match the original. We also stock a non-backlit version for this series.
